Package org.zvec.binding

Class LogConfig

java.lang.Object
org.zvec.binding.LogConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class LogConfig extends Object implements AutoCloseable
High-level wrapper for zvec_log_config_t. Created via the static factory methods createConsole(LogLevel) and createFile(LogLevel, String, String, int, int).
